reviews.title: Difficult to cancel subscription
reviews.text: On the 5th day of the trial period,  I decided this was too easy and that I would cancel. There is absolutely no place on the app to cancel the subscription. An email address would be nice but there is no way of contacting them! They indicate that they will remind you that the trial  period will end, but I did not receive a notification. I did receive a charge from Apple for the entire year and no way of stopping it. So am I to accept that for the rest of my life I need to pay for this app that is positively useless to me?
